}

    ims=[n for n,_,_ in pathways if pat.search(n)]
    print(label, 'immune pathways', len(ims), 'examples', ims[:10])

            k=len(hits & genes)
            p=hypergeom.sf(k-1, M, n, N) if k>0 else 1.0
            rows.append((name,rid,n,k,p))
        padj=multipletests([r[4] for r in rows], method='fdr_bh')[1]

        for label, pat in patterns.items():
            sig_imm=[r for r in sig if pat.search(r[0])]
            print(' ',label, len(sig_imm), 'top', [(r[0],r[3],r[5]) for r in sorted(sig_imm, key=lambda x:x[5])[:3]])

        r"immune|immun|cytokine|interleukin|interferon|toll|'"\\btlr\\b|antigen|mhc|tcr|bcr|\"
        r\"complement|natural killer|\\bnk\\b|neutrophil|macrophage|dendritic|inflam|chemokine|\"
        r\"tnf|fc receptor|pd-1|pd-l1|ctla|jak-stat|adaptive|innate\",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    all_results = pd.concat(
        [pathway_pvalues(gene_pvalues, pathways, condition) for condition in condition_columns],
        ignore_index=True,
    )
    all_results[\"immune_relevant\"] = all_results[\"pathway\"].str.contains(immune_pattern)
    all_results[\"significant\"] = all_results[\"adjusted_p_value\"] < 0.05

    significant_immune = all_results[all_results[\"immune_relevant\"] & all_results[\"significant\"]].copy()
    condition_summary = (
        significant_immune.groupby(\"condition\")
        .agg(
            significant_immune_pathways=(\"pathway\", \"count\"),
            best_adjusted_p_value=(\"adjusted_p_value\", \"min\"),
        )
        .reindex(condition_columns, fill_value=0)
        .reset_index()
    )
    condition_summary[\"included_after_excluding_no_t_cells\"] = condition_summary[\"condition\"].isin(screened_columns)
    condition_summary[\"has_significant_immune_pathway\"] = condition_summary[\"significant_immune_pathways\"] > 0

    included_summary = condition_summary[condition_summary[\"included_after_excluding_no_t_cells\"]]
    significant_conditions = int(included_summary[\"has_significant_immune_pathway\"].sum())
    total_conditions = int(included_summary.shape[0])
    percentage = 100 * significant_conditions / total_conditions if total_conditions else 0

    print(\"\\nCondition-level significant immune pathway summary:\")
    print(condition_summary.to_string(index=False))
    print(\"\\nTop significant immune pathways per included screening condition:\")
    top_rows = (
        significant_immune[significant_immune[\"condition\"].isin(screened_columns)]
        .sort_values([\"condition\", \"adjusted_p_value\"])
        .groupby(\"condition\")
        .head(5)
    )
    print(top_rows[[\"condition\", \"pathway\", \"n_genes\", \"adjusted_p_value\"]].to_string(index=False))
    print(f\"\\nSignificant included conditions: {significant_conditions}/{total_conditions}\")
    print(f\"Percentage: {percentage:.0f}%\")

    condition_summary.to_csv(SUMMARY_TSV, sep=\"\\t\", index=False)
    significant_immune.sort_values([\"condition\", \"adjusted_p_value\"]).to_csv(TOP_TSV, sep=\"\\t\", index=False)
    ANSWER_TXT.write_text(f\"<answer>{percentage:.0f}%</answer>\\n\")
